problem: Website browser quality was split across several Chromium-centric checks and did not retain one explicit cross-browser screenshot matrix for mobile/tablet/desktop.
root_cause: Existing release checks covered visibility and selected visual geometry, but cross-engine screenshot evidence was not one canonical scheduled contract.
decision: Reuse existing website lane and add one daily cross-browser screenshot assurance over the production sitemap and representative route families.
prevention: Every sitemap route gets responsive mobile+desktop DOM checks.
Critical route families get full screenshots in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
All failures retain screenshots and report evidence.
